title: Marex brings institutional-grade currency risk management solutions to French corporates
summary: Marex expands its Corporate FX business into France, providing French companies with tailored hedging strategies and foreign exchange risk management.
body_markdown:
Marex is pleased to announce the expansion of its Corporate FX business into France, bringing institutional-grade foreign exchange risk management solutions to French corporates with exposure to international markets.


The expansion builds on Marex’s enhanced Corporate FX capabilities following the acquisition of Hamilton Court Group and reflects the firm’s continued investment in supporting businesses across Europe, with a view to extend its capabilities to payments.


As French companies continue to expand internationally, managing currency risk has become an increasingly critical part of protecting profitability, improving forecasting certainty and supporting long-term growth.


Marex’s Corporate FX offering provides companies with access to a comprehensive suite of solutions from cash to bespoke exotic derivatives, including spot FX, forwards, swaps, market orders and structured hedging strategies. Clients also benefit from access to deep liquidity, market insight, risk management expertise and dedicated relationship support.


Clients can also access FX Cash execution across spot, forwards and swaps with advanced FX Volatility capabilities, enabling the pricing, execution and management of FX options strategies within a single digital environment.


Chirag Sachdev, Managing Director, Marex FX, commented:


*“France is a strategically important market with a sophisticated treasury community and a large number of internationally active businesses. We see a significant opportunity to bring Marex’s expanded FX capabilities and expertise to French companies looking to manage currency risk more effectively.”*


David Cohen, Head of Marex Hedging Solutions, added:


*“Businesses today face a complex risk landscape, from foreign exchange volatility to fluctuations in commodity and energy markets. Our approach is to help clients build risk management strategies that support their broader commercial objectives.”*


Whether supporting exporters, importers, multinational groups or private-equity-backed businesses, Marex works closely with clients to develop bespoke hedging strategies aligned with their commercial objectives and risk appetite.


The expansion into France represents another step in Marex’s commitment to helping corporates navigate increasingly complex global markets with confidence.
